_about: Hand corrections for the Roots maps. 'people' fixes what the extractor read from a person's record (deceased people only: this file is public). 'queries' gives the geocoder a better search for a place. 'coords' pins a place by hand (always wins); give a source for each. approx: 1 = near the spot, 2 = an area (county, state, zone).
